anomalies.observed: On the DISPLAY sheet (display.kicad_sch) the SSD1306 interface-select strapping pins are tied as BS0 (pin 10) -> VCC, BS1 (pin 11) -> GND, BS2 (pin 12) -> VCC (the two outer BS wires rise to the VCC rail that also feeds R4, while the middle BS wire drops to the GND symbol).
anomalies.expected: The specification states the I2C-mode strapping BS2,BS1,BS0 = 0,1,0, i.e. 'BS0 (pin 10) -> GND; BS1 (pin 11) -> VCC; BS2 (pin 12) -> GND'. The drawing shows the inverse (1,0,1).

evidence.quote: BS0 (pin 10) -> GND; BS1 (pin 11) -> VCC; BS2 (pin 12) -> GND ... That BS2,BS1,BS0 = 0,1,0 strapping ... is the SSD1306's documented I2C-mode pin configuration
display.kicad_sch: U4 pins 10/11/12 (BS0/BS1/BS2) wired to VCC/GND/VCC respectively

anomalies.impact: The SSD1306 is strapped to a non-I2C (SPI-style, 101) interface mode, so the MCU's I2C signals routed to D0/D1/D2 (DISP_SCL/DISP_SDA) will not be interpreted as an I2C bus. The OLED display would fail to communicate / not initialise.

parsed.summary: All passive values, pull-ups, decoupling, NFC/TSC/SWD connectivity match the specification, but the SSD1306 BS0/BS1/BS2 strapping on the display sheet appears inverted (BS0,BS2 to VCC and BS1 to GND) relative to the spec's required I2C configuration (BS0,BS2 to GND, BS1 to VCC), which would put the display in the wrong interface mode.
